statements: CREATE TRIGGER `imc_schedule_mapping_imc008_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `IMC008_Schedule` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.home_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.home_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT m.sm_world_club_id)=1 THEN MIN(m.sm_world_club_id) ELSE NULL END FROM IMC_Game_World_Club_Mapping m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_world_club_id IS NOT NULL AND m.sm_world_club_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(m.club_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.home_name))),NEW.home_sm_team_id),NEW.home_sm_team_id), NEW.away_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.away_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.away_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT m.sm_world_club_id)=1 THEN MIN(m.sm_world_club_id) ELSE NULL END FROM IMC_Game_World_Club_Mapping m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_world_club_id IS NOT NULL AND m.sm_world_club_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(m.club_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.away_name))),NEW.away_sm_team_id),NEW.away_sm_team_id)

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_schedule_mapping_imc008_bu` BEFORE UPDATE ON `IMC008_Schedule` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.home_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.home_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT m.sm_world_club_id)=1 THEN MIN(m.sm_world_club_id) ELSE NULL END FROM IMC_Game_World_Club_Mapping m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_world_club_id IS NOT NULL AND m.sm_world_club_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(m.club_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.home_name))),NEW.home_sm_team_id),NEW.home_sm_team_id), NEW.away_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.away_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.away_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT m.sm_world_club_id)=1 THEN MIN(m.sm_world_club_id) ELSE NULL END FROM IMC_Game_World_Club_Mapping m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_world_club_id IS NOT NULL AND m.sm_world_club_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(m.club_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.away_name))),NEW.away_sm_team_id),NEW.away_sm_team_id)

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_results_nations_gw008_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `IMC008_Results` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.competition_group='NATIONS' AND NEW.match_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `IMC008_Match_Reports` m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id),COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.sm_manager_id)=1 THEN MAX(c.sm_manager_id) ELSE NULL END FROM `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Codex Global` c ON c.manager_id=a.manager_id WHERE a.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND a.assignment_type='national_team' AND a.national_team_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id AND a.start_date<=NEW.match_date AND (a.end_date IS NULL OR a.end_date>=NEW.match_date) AND c.sm_manager_id>0),NEW.home_sm_manager_id),NEW.home_sm_manager_id), NEW.away_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.competition_group='NATIONS' AND NEW.match_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `IMC008_Match_Reports` m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id),COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.sm_manager_id)=1 THEN MAX(c.sm_manager_id) ELSE NULL END FROM `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Codex Global` c ON c.manager_id=a.manager_id WHERE a.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND a.assignment_type='national_team' AND a.national_team_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id AND a.start_date<=NEW.match_date AND (a.end_date IS NULL OR a.end_date>=NEW.match_date) AND c.sm_manager_id>0),NEW.away_sm_manager_id),NEW.away_sm_manager_id)

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_results_playoff_imc008_bu` BEFORE UPDATE ON `IMC008_Results` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.competition_key=IF(NEW.sm_action='playoff' AND NEW.home_sm_club_id>0 AND NEW.away_sm_club_id>0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT r.competition_key)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.sm_division)=1 AND SUM((r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id))>0 AND SUM((r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id))>0 THEN REPLACE(MAX(r.competition_key),'|league|','|playoff|') ELSE NULL END FROM IMC008_Results r WHERE r.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND r.imc_season=NEW.imc_season AND r.sm_action='league' AND r.competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND r.sm_division REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND r.competition_key LIKE CONCAT(NEW.game_world_id,'|%|league|',r.sm_division) AND ((r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id) OR (r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id))),NEW.competition_key),NEW.competition_key), NEW.sm_division=IF(NEW.sm_action='playoff' AND NEW.home_sm_club_id>0 AND NEW.away_sm_club_id>0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT r.competition_key)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.sm_division)=1 AND SUM((r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id))>0 AND SUM((r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id))>0 THEN MAX(r.sm_division) ELSE NULL END FROM IMC008_Results r WHERE r.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND r.imc_season=NEW.imc_season AND r.sm_action='league' AND r.competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND r.sm_division REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND r.competition_key LIKE CONCAT(NEW.game_world_id,'|%|league|',r.sm_division) AND ((r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id) OR (r.home_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id OR r.away_sm_club_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id))),NEW.sm_division),NEW.sm_division)

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_results_clubs_gw008_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `IMC008_Results` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.competition_group IN ('DOMESTIC','INTERNATIONAL') AND NEW.match_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `IMC008_Match_Reports` m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id),COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.sm_manager_id)=1 THEN MAX(c.sm_manager_id) ELSE NULL END FROM `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Codex Global` c ON c.manager_id=a.manager_id WHERE a.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND a.assignment_type='club' AND a.team_id=NEW.home_sm_club_id AND a.start_date<=NEW.match_date AND (a.end_date IS NULL OR a.end_date>=NEW.match_date) AND c.sm_manager_id>0),NEW.home_sm_manager_id),NEW.home_sm_manager_id), NEW.away_sm_manager_id=IF(NEW.competition_group IN ('DOMESTIC','INTERNATIONAL') AND NEW.match_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `IMC008_Match_Reports` m WHERE m.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND m.sm_fixture_id=NEW.sm_fixture_id),COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.sm_manager_id)=1 THEN MAX(c.sm_manager_id) ELSE NULL END FROM `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `Sql1956795_1`.`IMC Manager Codex Global` c ON c.manager_id=a.manager_id WHERE a.game_world_id=NEW.game_world_id AND a.assignment_type='club' AND a.team_id=NEW.away_sm_club_id AND a.start_date<=NEW.match_date AND (a.end_date IS NULL OR a.end_date>=NEW.match_date) AND c.sm_manager_id>0),NEW.away_sm_manager_id),NEW.away_sm_manager_id)

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_nexus_imc008_schedule_ai` AFTER INSERT ON `IMC008_Schedule` FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO `IMC_Site_Schedule` (`game_world_id`,`imc_season`,`sm_fixture_id`,`competition_key`,`sm_action`,`sm_country`,`sm_division`,`competition_group`,`competition_stage`,`competition_round`,`match_date`,`match_time`,`home_sm_team_id`,`home_name`,`away_sm_team_id`,`away_name`,`home_sm_manager_id`,`away_sm_manager_id`,`logged_manager_id`,`fingerprint`,source_key,synced_at) VALUES (NEW.`game_world_id`,NEW.`imc_season`,NEW.`sm_fixture_id`,NEW.`competition_key`,NEW.`sm_action`,NEW.`sm_country`,NEW.`sm_division`,NEW.`competition_group`,NEW.`competition_stage`,NEW.`competition_round`,NEW.`match_date`,NEW.`match_time`,NEW.`home_sm_team_id`,NEW.`home_name`,NEW.`away_sm_team_id`,NEW.`away_name`,NEW.`home_sm_manager_id`,NEW.`away_sm_manager_id`,NEW.`logged_manager_id`,NEW.`fingerprint`,SHA2(CONCAT('IMC Schedule|',NEW.game_world_id,'|',NEW.sm_fixture_id),256),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `game_world_id`=VALUES(`game_world_id`),`imc_season`=VALUES(`imc_season`),`sm_fixture_id`=VALUES(`sm_fixture_id`),`competition_key`=VALUES(`competition_key`),`sm_action`=VALUES(`sm_action`),`sm_country`=VALUES(`sm_country`),`sm_division`=VALUES(`sm_division`),`competition_group`=VALUES(`competition_group`),`competition_stage`=VALUES(`competition_stage`),`competition_round`=VALUES(`competition_round`),`match_date`=VALUES(`match_date`),`match_time`=VALUES(`match_time`),`home_sm_team_id`=VALUES(`home_sm_team_id`),`home_name`=VALUES(`home_name`),`away_sm_team_id`=VALUES(`away_sm_team_id`),`away_name`=VALUES(`away_name`),`home_sm_manager_id`=VALUES(`home_sm_manager_id`),`away_sm_manager_id`=VALUES(`away_sm_manager_id`),`logged_manager_id`=VALUES(`logged_manager_id`),`fingerprint`=VALUES(`fingerprint`),synced_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_nexus_imc008_schedule_ad` AFTER DELETE ON `IMC008_Schedule` FOR EACH ROW DELETE FROM `IMC_Site_Schedule` WHERE source_key=SHA2(CONCAT('IMC Schedule|',OLD.game_world_id,'|',OLD.sm_fixture_id),256)

CREATE TRIGGER `imc_schedule_teamid_imc008_bi` BEFORE INSERT ON `IMC008_Schedule` FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.home_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.home_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.home_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT z.team_id)=1 THEN MIN(z.team_id) ELSE NULL END FROM (SELECT home_name team_name,home_sm_club_id team_id FROM IMC008_Results UNION ALL SELECT away_name,away_sm_club_id FROM IMC008_Results) z WHERE z.team_id IS NOT NULL AND z.team_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(z.team_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.home_name))),NEW.home_sm_team_id),NEW.home_sm_team_id), NEW.away_sm_team_id=IF(NEW.away_sm_team_id IS NULL OR NEW.away_sm_team_id=0,COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT z.team_id)=1 THEN MIN(z.team_id) ELSE NULL END FROM (SELECT home_name team_name,home_sm_club_id team_id FROM IMC008_Results UNION ALL SELECT away_name,away_sm_club_id FROM IMC008_Results) z WHERE z.team_id IS NOT NULL AND z.team_id<>0 AND LOWER(TRIM(z.team_name))=LOWER(TRIM(NEW.away_name))),NEW.away_sm_team_id),NEW.away_sm_team_id)
